Fixed the create-pantoken-app eval failures:

1. **Token budget (root cause of all 4 failures)**: `eval.yaml`'s `max_tokens: 1200` was never achievable — even a trivial "tell me a joke" negative-trigger prompt used 17.8k tokens due to `copilot-sdk`'s baseline session overhead. Bumped to `150000` in both [create-pantoken-app/eval.yaml](ai/pantoken-ai/evals/create-pantoken-app/eval.yaml) and [init-pantoken/eval.yaml](ai/pantoken-ai/evals/init-pantoken/eval.yaml) (same misconfiguration was copy-pasted into both), based on observed real-run maxima.

2. **Positive Trigger 2 keyword miss (`@pantoken/next`)**: with an empty eval workspace, the model asked for clarification instead of following [SKILL.md](ai/pantoken-ai/skills/create-pantoken-app/SKILL.md)'s existing "no `package.json` + user wants a web project → run `npm init -y`, proceed with the chosen framework" rule. Clarified that rule applies even when the user calls the project "existing."

Re-ran both suites — create-pantoken-app went from 0/4 to 3/4 passing (all token-budget failures gone); init-pantoken's token-budget failures are also gone. Remaining failures are single-trial flakiness where the model legitimately asks a clarifying question (package manager/directory) before saying "pantoken" — a single-turn eval artifact of the skill's interactive design, not a content defect; not something I patched since it'd mean over-tuning wording just to force a keyword match. Recorded the token-budget lesson in repo memory to avoid reusing 1200 as a template default.
